claim: November5 prospective PM judgment, saved at actual persistence time after Kevin approved a USD5m-equivalent EURUSD long. The trade owns possible continued unwinding of dollar political/geopolitical demand and benefits to Europe's outlook from energy relief. It does not require EUR-specific outperformance versus every European peer. The report rejected EUR for lacking an identified residual; I overrode that investment conclusion while accepting its independently checked arithmetic. A0.79% rally already in the close, a5Y rank around66 and missing executable forwards do not establish that the adjustment is exhausted. Political results do not prove peace or a durable oil decline. Initial size is deliberately small because the causal interpretation is uncertain, the exit is inside ordinary movement and targets are judgmental reference ranges rather than fair-value estimates. This is not a response to Kevin instructing a EUR trade; he coached process and later approved my proposal. The November4 close predates this forecast and is not an out-of-sample success.

competing_explanations.statement: The election-day European currency rally may have been a largely complete positioning adjustment rather than a continuing macro repricing.
Cheaper energy can strengthen US demand and maintain tight Fed policy as well as help Europe.
The supplied target markers, a cloned move and sample median, are not independent economic fair values; the thesis may be wrong despite attractive conditional payoff arithmetic.
